proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on, two waiting --review-family items with no live eligible seat yield a relaxation witness for a seat of another session than the builder.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case a regression in the required-family relaxation witness would pass the gate unnoticed.

proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily off, reviewFamilyRelaxation and confirmFamilyRelaxation yield null for a --review-family item.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case a regression in the off-by-default setting would pass the gate unnoticed.

proves.claim: with review.relaxRequiredFamily on, a sensitive --review-family item yields no relaxation witness.

store.io-board-review-family-relax-requi.why: Without this case a sensitive item could be reviewed by a seat of the wrong family once the setting is on.
